text:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up: Olivia's birthday is next Thursday (June 3). Quick poll: tea & biscotti at 3pm or cupcakes at 3:15? low-key, remote folks can join for a 3-min hi. vote with emoji please :tada:
Olivia: I'm excited! Either is fine. tea sounds cozy. :)
Hector: Cupcakes are faster to set up. :cupcake:
Sana: Tea + biscotti for me. please caffeine-free herbal option too.
Tom: Cupcakes + card. also can someone add a calendar stub so people know when to pop by?
hr-bot: Reminder: include allergen labels on shared food and avoid loose glitter or confetti.
Lana: If cupcakes, can we include a GF option? happy to pick them up.
Ivy: Remote — I'll Venmo $6 either way.
Maya (People Ops): Tentative plan: tea station with herbal option + biscotti and a small card on Olivia's desk. Suggested contribution $6 (link to pool will be posted). Calendar invite "Olivia - drop by & hi" 2:55-3:10; remote cameo at 3:03. Anyone object?
Olivia: Love it, thanks everyone! no singing necessary :smile:
Hector: I'll bring the biscotti and labels.
Lana: I'll get a GF biscotti pack.
Ivy: Sent $6 to the pool (https://pay.example/giftpool/olivia).
Maya (People Ops): Calendar invite created. Card will be on the shelf. Will post final confirmation once pool is closed. Thanks team :sparkles:
